answer: Grade the graders. Every juror's verdict is resampled one tier up and audited against seeded honeypots plus the consensus of other established panels perched on their own knoll. A ring that rubber-stamps a planted fake streaks past like a comet, so the meta-jury above slashes its bonds and suspends the whole clique. Who audits whom reshuffles each epoch, so no colluding group crosses the same mesa twice. To farm approvals an attacker must capture an honest quorum at every tier at once; 1000 clones still need a freshly-drawn corrupted quorum per layer, so cost scales per tier, not per clone.
